login.body: Your {{store_name}} login OTP is {{otp_code}}. Valid for 10 minutes. Please do not share this with anyone.

registration.body: Welcome to {{store_name}}! Use OTP {{otp_code}} to complete your registration.

forgot_password.body: Your password reset OTP for {{store_name}} is {{otp_code}}. Do not share this OTP.

mobile_verification.body: Your mobile verification OTP for {{store_name}} is {{otp_code}}.

welcome.body: Hello {{customer_name}}, welcome to {{store_name}}! Your account is ready. Enjoy fresh groceries delivered to your door.

birthday.body: 🎉 Happy Birthday {{customer_name}}! Wishing you joy and prosperity from everyone at {{store_name}}. Enjoy a special shopping experience today!

anniversary.body: 💐 Happy Anniversary {{customer_name}}! Warmest wishes on your special milestone from the team at {{store_name}}.

placed.body: Hi {{customer_name}}, your order #{{order_number}} for ₹{{grand_total}} has been placed successfully at {{store_name}} via {{payment_method}}.

confirmed.body: Great news {{customer_name}}! Your order #{{order_number}} has been confirmed and is being prepped. Delivery area: {{delivery_area}} - {{delivery_sub_area}}.

processing.body: Your order #{{order_number}} is currently being packed with utmost care at {{store_name}}.

ready.body: Your order #{{order_number}} is packed and ready for dispatch.

out_for_delivery.body: Order #{{order_number}} is out for delivery to {{delivery_address}}! Slot: {{delivery_slot}}.

delivered.body: Order #{{order_number}} has been delivered successfully! Thank you for choosing {{store_name}}.

cancelled.body: Order #{{order_number}} has been cancelled. Any applicable refunds or welcome bonus reversals have been processed.

returned.body: Order #{{order_number}} return has been recorded. Our team will contact you shortly.

initiated.body: Payment attempt initiated for Order #{{order_number}} of amount ₹{{amount}}.

success.body: Payment of ₹{{amount}} for Order #{{order_number}} via {{payment_method}} was successful. Reference: {{transaction_ref}}.

failed.body: Payment for Order #{{order_number}} failed. Please retry your payment or choose Cash on Delivery.

refunded.body: Refund of ₹{{amount}} for Order #{{order_number}} has been processed.

activated.body: Welcome to VIP! Your {{membership_name}} membership is active until {{expiry_date}}. Enjoy free delivery and exclusive member discounts!

expiring.body: Your {{membership_name}} membership at {{store_name}} expires on {{expiry_date}}. Renew today to keep your perks!

expired.body: Your {{membership_name}} membership has expired. Visit {{store_name}} to renew.

received.body: 🎉 Congratulations! ₹{{bonus_amount}} welcome bonus credited to your account. Use it on your next grocery order above ₹{{min_order}}!

redeemed.body: ₹{{bonus_amount}} welcome bonus was applied to Order #{{order_number}}. Happy savings!

expired.body: Your promotional credit of ₹{{bonus_amount}} has expired.

new_order.body: 🚨 [ADMIN ALERT] New {{source}} Order #{{order_number}} received! Amount: ₹{{grand_total}} | Customer: {{customer_name}} ({{customer_phone}}) | Area: {{delivery_area}} - {{delivery_sub_area}}.

payment_failure.body: ⚠️ [ADMIN ALERT] Payment failed for Order #{{order_number}}. Customer: {{customer_phone}}.

order_cancelled.body: ⚠️ [ADMIN ALERT] Order #{{order_number}} was cancelled. Check dashboard.
